name: notebook_kernel_config_spec
description: Discover portable native kernel settings, defaults, path bases and apply semantics. No open notebook or installed kernel is required.

name: notebook_configure_kernel
description: Validate or save a notebook-local C++/Rust profile. Discover config fields with notebook_kernel_config_spec. Omit profile and make_default together to update the current default, or select/create default when unset. Explicit profile preserves its stable identity and changes the default only with make_default=true; make_default requires profile. dry_run allocates no identity and changes nothing. next_start saves only; restart saves first and restarts only the selected profile. Writes require document generation and a UUID for exact retries.

config.description: Exact kernel-specific config schema returned by notebook_kernel_config_spec

make_default.description: Requires profile; only true changes the default pointer

expected_version.description: Notebook document generation, required for writes

name: notebook_kernel_profiles
description: Inspect notebook-local native definitions, stable profile IDs and derived opaque slots before launch, default/factory targets, readiness, process generations and diagnostics. Read-only: no migration, allocation, provisioning or process changes. One invalid definition is reported alongside all other definitions.
